article_title: X-planes: Are they needed in the new era of drones?

tasks.prompt: What central issue does the article examine?
options: Whether experimental crewed aircraft still have value when drones and computer modelling are increasingly capable
Whether Concorde should immediately return to commercial service
Why Nasa has stopped testing aircraft in flight
How Ukraine became the first country to build an X-plane
tasks.correct_answer: Whether experimental crewed aircraft still have value when drones and computer modelling are increasingly capable
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת האם עדיין יש צורך במטוסי ניסוי מאוישים לצד רחפנים, סימולטורים ומודלים ממוחשבים, ומציגה טיעונים בעד שתי הגישות.

tasks.prompt: What is the X-59 designed primarily to demonstrate?
options: A new method for launching spacecraft from bombers
That an elongated shape can reduce a sonic boom to a more acceptable sound
That passenger aircraft can fly without landing gear
A fully autonomous fighter controlled only from the ground
tasks.correct_answer: That an elongated shape can reduce a sonic boom to a more acceptable sound
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המטרה המצומצמת של X-59 היא להחליש את הבום העל־קולי באמצעות חרטום מוארך ולהפוך אותו לרעש נסבל יותר.

tasks.prompt: What does the article mean when it says the X-59 has a remarkable “lineage”?
options: It was built entirely from one older aircraft.
Its pilots all belong to the same family.
It belongs to a long historical sequence of experimental X-planes.
It can trace its flight path without satellite navigation.
tasks.correct_answer: It belongs to a long historical sequence of experimental X-planes.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: lineage פירושו שושלת או רצף היסטורי; X-59 מוצג כהמשך למסורת מטוסי הניסוי שהחלה ב־X-1 בשנת 1947.

tasks.prompt: Why did Nasa decide that an uncrewed X-59 would not necessarily be cheaper?
options: Drones are unable to travel faster than sound.
The aircraft was too small to hold remote-control equipment.
Nasa had no experience with uncrewed X-planes.
Certifying a fast robot aircraft over urban areas would add cost and complexity.
tasks.correct_answer: Certifying a fast robot aircraft over urban areas would add cost and complexity.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הסרת הטייס הייתה מחייבת אישור מורכב ויקר למטוס רובוטי מהיר שטס מעל אזורים עירוניים, ולכן לא הבטיחה חיסכון.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what is a technology “testbed”?
options: A platform used to try and evaluate new systems or designs in realistic conditions
A bedroom reserved for test pilots between flights
A computer model that can never be flown
A factory that produces aircraft for regular passenger service
tasks.correct_answer: A platform used to try and evaluate new systems or designs in realistic conditions
tasks.explanation_hebrew: testbed הוא פלטפורמת ניסוי המשמשת לבדיקת טכנולוגיות ומערכות בפועל לפני שילובן בכלי מבצעי או מסחרי.

tasks.prompt: Why does Guy Gratton argue that removing pilots can reduce the quality of flight testing?
options: Pilots always make aircraft cheaper to manufacture.
Human pilots can notice lessons and behaviour that ground teams may miss.
Ground crews are legally forbidden to monitor drones.
Crewed aircraft never require certification.
tasks.correct_answer: Human pilots can notice lessons and behaviour that ground teams may miss.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: גרטון טוען שטייס בתוך המטוס מספק משוב ישיר ומזהה תופעות שעלולות ללכת לאיבוד כאשר המידע מגיע בעקיפין לצוותי קרקע.

tasks.prompt: Give two examples from the article of how earlier experimental aircraft advanced aviation.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני מטוסי ניסוי או תוכניות ולתאר בקצרה את ההישג או התרומה של כל אחד.
expected_points: The Bell X-1 became the first aircraft to break the sound barrier in 1947.
The X-15 reached Mach 6.7 and helped develop heat-resistant materials used for the Space Shuttle.
The X-48 tested a blended wing-and-fuselage lifting-body concept.
The UK's EAP tested core systems that later contributed to the Typhoon fighter.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article suggest future X-planes will probably be uncrewed only in some cases?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את תנאי ההחלטה ולשלב לפחות שיקול אחד לטובת כלי בלתי מאויש ושיקול אחד לטובת טייס.
expected_points: Uncrewed aircraft may be suitable when the research does not concern piloting and when they reduce cost or risk.
A crew may be preferable when pilot feedback is part of the technology being studied.
Certification and large ground teams can make drones more expensive or complicated than expected.
Aircraft intended to carry people may require lessons that are best captured with a human in the loop.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the X-plane approach and explain how the X-59 illustrates it.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך להסביר את עקרון המטרה המצומצמת, את בעיית הבום העל־קולי, את תכנון X-59 ואת דרך איסוף הראיות.
expected_points: X-planes are built around a small number of focused questions to control cost.
The X-59 tests whether its long nose can turn sonic booms into acceptable background sounds.
It reuses components from several existing aircraft while serving one main research goal.
Nasa combines flight data with community surveys over selected US towns.

tasks.prompt: Using evidence from the article, evaluate whether crewed experimental aircraft remain necessary in modern aerospace research.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג עמדה מאוזנת, להשתמש בלפחות שתי ראיות מן הכתבה, להתייחס ליתרונות כלי טיס בלתי מאוישים ולסיים במסקנה מנומקת.
expected_points: Drones can reduce scale, risk or cost, as illustrated by the small X-48.
However, autonomous certification and large ground teams can create hidden costs.
Pilots can identify behaviour and practical lessons that indirect monitoring or simulation may miss.
The best choice depends on whether the research concerns piloting, human transport and cost-effectiveness.
